import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
 
public class Solution 
{
    static class FastScanner
    {
        private BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;
        
        FastScanner(InputStream in)
        {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in));
        }
        
        String next() throws IOException
        {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens())
            {
                String line = br.readLine();
                if (line == null) return null;
                st = new StringTokenizer(line);
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }
        
        int nextInt() throws IOException
        {
            String s = next();
            if (s == null) throw new InputMismatchException();
            return Integer.parseInt(s);
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException
    {
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner(System.in);
        int n = fs.nextInt();
        int b = fs.nextInt();
        
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            a[i] = fs.nextInt();
        }
        
        int[] odd = new int[n + 1];
        int[] even = new int[n + 1];
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        {
            if ((a[i - 1] & 1) == 1)
            {
                odd[i] = odd[i - 1] + 1;
                even[i] = even[i - 1];
            }
            else
            {
                odd[i] = odd[i - 1];
                even[i] = even[i - 1] + 1;
            }
        }
        
        PriorityQueue<Integer> costs = new PriorityQueue<Integer>();
        int prev = 0;
        
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)
        {
            if (odd[i] - odd[prev] == even[i] - even[prev])
            {
                costs.add(Math.abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]));
                prev = i;
            }
        }
        
        int sum = 0;
        int count = 0;
        
        while (!costs.isEmpty() && sum <= b)
        {
            sum += costs.poll();
            count++;
        }
        
        if (count == 0)
        {
            System.out.println("0");
        }
        else if (costs.isEmpty() && sum <= b)
        {
            System.out.println(count);
        }
        else
        {
            System.out.println(count - 1);
        }
    }
}

            next = read();
        }
        
        private int read()
        {
            try

                return in.read();
            }
            catch (IOException e)

                throw new RuntimeException(e);

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Solution
{
    static class ByteScanner
    {
        private final byte[] data;
        private int pos;
        
        ByteScanner(byte[] data)
        {
            this.data = data;
        }
        
        private boolean isSpace(int c)
        {
            return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t';
        }
        
        private void skip()
        {
            while (pos < data.length && isSpace(data[pos])) pos++;
        }
        
        int nextInt()
        {
            skip();
            if (pos >= data.length) throw new InputMismatchException();
            
            int sign = 1;
            if (data[pos] == '-')
            {
                sign = -1;
                pos++;
            }
            
            int num = 0;
            while (pos < data.length && !isSpace(data[pos]))
            {
                num = num * 10 + (data[pos] - '0');
                pos++;
            }
            return num * sign;
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException
    {
        ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] buffer = new byte[4096];
        int read;
        
        while ((read = System.in.read(buffer)) != -1)
        {
            bos.write(buffer, 0, read);
        }
        
        ByteScanner in = new ByteScanner(bos.toByteArray());
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int b = in.nextInt();
        
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            a[i] = in.nextInt();
        }
        
        List<Integer> costs = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        int balance = 0;
        int prevBalance = 0;
        
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)
        {
            if ((a[i - 1] & 1) == 1) balance++;
            else balance--;
            
            if (balance == prevBalance)
            {
                costs.add(Math.abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]));
                prevBalance = balance;
            }
        }
        
        Collections.sort(costs);
        int total = 0;
        int ans = 0;
        
        for (int c : costs)
        {
            if (total + c > b) break;
            total += c;
            ans++;
        }
        
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
